accepted.requirement: Reach parse_ex number continuation with saved exponent text on the same tokener.
accepted.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates a tokener, calls parse_ex once with the whole input, then frees it.
accepted.failure_condition: A valid split such as first chunk "[0e" followed by "-1]" requires retained number state; no fuzzer input can make this entry issue the second call.
accepted.alternative_paths: A single call can parse the combined spelling, but does not exercise the supported continuation state or its reconstruction; the complete entry has no other parse sequence.

accepted.requirement: Reach strict-mode parsing of incomplete exponents within the parse_ex operational surface.
accepted.target_route: The entry creates a zero-initialized default tokener and calls parse_ex without json_tokener_set_flags.
accepted.failure_condition: For example, "[0e]" has a strict-mode number-error outcome, but input bytes cannot set the tokener's strict flag.
accepted.alternative_paths: Other malformed default-mode inputs can produce an error, but cannot exercise the strict-mode outcome for this input; the complete entry contains no configuration call.

source_evidence.quote:
/* The behavior when missing the exponent varies slightly */
    {"0e", 2, 2, json_tokener_continue, 1},
    {"0e", 3, 2, json_tokener_success, 1},
    {"0e", 3, 2, json_tokener_error_parse_eof, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
    {"[0e]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1},
    {"[0e]", -1, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},

    {"0e+", 3, 3, json_tokener_continue, 1},
    {"0e+", 4, 3, json_tokener_success, 1},
    {"0e+", 4, 3, json_tokener_error_parse_eof, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
    {"[0e+]", -1, -1, json_tokener_success, 1},
    {"[0e+]", -1, 4, json_tokener_error_parse_number, 1, JSON_TOKENER_STRICT},
